replies.author: Luciferrrro
replies.body:
Deterministic algorithms/simple ML are bad for removing backgrounds for sprites unless source image has solid edges which is not the case for AI generated images. Because they simply don't know which pixel on the edge is an object or background.

You need AI tool to remove background fully. It's usually in practice regenerating image but without background. For animated sprites good results can be achieved by generating video with transparent background (Wan-alpha for example) and then cut frames from it.

replies.author: AustinMHowe

“Transparent backgrounds are available in preview for gpt-image-2. Setbackground: "transparent" to request one. Use png (the default) or webp; jpeg isn’t supported with transparent backgrounds.”

It technically could generate transparent before but was always a coin flip on whether it was actually transparent or a fake transparent checkerboard background. So I’m betting it’s an internal prompt update they evaled for consistency for the api change.
